name: uberasm-sprites-are-always-in-water
title: Sprites Are Always In Water
description:
This sets all values in the "Sprites In Liquid Indicator" table to #$01 - "In Water", as well as removing the splash graphic.

Basically if you enable sprite buoyancy in a level using this code you can replicate that glitch that lets sprites act like they're inside of water when they aren't, like in Faux Water by Sixcorby
